scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n backend,frontend -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:clean: rm -rf frontend/dist frontend/node_modules/.vite && npm run dev
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace backend && npm run build --workspace frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace backend && playwright test
scripts.prod:up: bash scripts/compose-production.sh down --remove-orphans && bash scripts/compose-production.sh up -d --remove-orphans
